recognize_zh: 低倍下組織被成片、胞質淡染的大型異型細胞浸潤，周圍夾雜深染的小淋巴球；插圖高倍可見圓至卵圓形泡狀核、明顯核仁與較豐富的胞質，提示大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤，需以 IHC 與癌轉移區分。
features: Sheets and nests of large atypical cells, roughly 3-4 times the size of adjacent small lymphocytes
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli (inset)
Moderate to abundant pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Cohesive-appearing, vaguely nested growth that can mimic carcinoma
Background of numerous small mature lymphocytes; adjacent fibroadipose tissue at the periphery
describe_en: Sections show a cellular lymphoid tissue fragment effaced by vaguely nested sheets of large atypical cells admixed with a background of small mature lymphocytes, with adjacent fibroadipose tissue at the edge. At high power (inset), the large cells have round to oval vesicular nuclei, distinct nucleoli, and moderate to abundant pale cytoplasm. The cohesive, nested pattern raises carcinoma, melanoma, and large cell lymphoma in the differential, requiring immunohistochemistry. In conjunction with diffuse CD45 and PAX5 positivity on companion stains, findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma is keratin positive and CD45/PAX5 negative, whereas these cells are CD45+ and PAX5+; PAX8 reactivity in B cells can be antibody cross-reactivity.

Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background, are CD45 negative and only weakly PAX5 positive with CD30/CD15 expression, unlike these sheets of CD45+ strongly PAX5+ cells.
ALCL has hallmark kidney-shaped nuclei, sinusoidal growth, strong CD30, and is PAX5 negative.
Melanoma expresses S100/SOX10/HMB45 and is negative for CD45 and PAX5.
